title: Covariance and product inner product
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f,g:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. Their covariance under the product distribution with one-coordinate law $\pi$ equals their product inner product minus the product of their means.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
